PM1611-WD - Smart Prepaid Energy Meter

PM1611-WD - smart prepaid energy meter dengan koneksi WiFi & Modbus. Cocok untuk rumah sewa, kos-kosan, dan pabrik dengan tenant terpisah. Integrasi langsung dengan SURGE Energy Mapping untuk billing & monitoring real-time.

PM1611-WD

Aplikasi

Di mana PM1611-WD digunakan

Apartments Boarding House (Kos) Rental Property Retail Tenants Office Sub-Metering Industrial Sub-Billing Marketplace Stalls Workshop & SOHO
Manajemen Prepaid Energy Cerdas, Aman, dan Efisien

Kontrol penggunaan energi, eliminasi sengketa billing, dan tingkatkan efisiensi operasional dengan PM1611-WD Prepaid Energy Meter IoT. Dirancang untuk rental space, kios, kantor, dan mesin, this smart meter combines precision energi measurement with IoT connectivity. Giving you full control anytime, anywhere.

Ambil kontrol penuh atas konsumsi daya Anda.
Dengan PM1611-WD, Anda bisa monitor, kelola, dan amankan penggunaan energi memastikan billing adil, mencegah pemborosan, dan optimasi performa.

Fitur Utama

Why landlords & operators choose PM1611-WD

01

Billing Prepaid Token

Token-based credit system eliminates billing disputes. Tenants top-up; meter auto-memutus saat saldo nol.

02

Connect/Disconnect Remote

Built-in relay memungkinkan remote service control via WiFi/4G. Tanpa kunjungan lokasi for activation or disconnection.

03

Konfigurasi Multi-Tarif

Set peak/off-peak rates, flat tariffs, custom plans. Auto-calculate based on time-of-use schedules per tenant.

04

LCD + Alert Mobile

Local LCD shows balance and consumption. WhatsApp/SMS notifications on low balance, anomalies, and top-ups.

05

Tracking Penggunaan Historis

Review up to 6 days of detailed energi usage per tenant. Identify abnormal consumption and resolve disputes with data.

06

Portal Manajemen Web

Configure and monitor remotely via web interface using Blynk or MQTT protocol. RTC with NTP sync memastikan accurate billing time.

Pesan di Tokopedia → Unduh Datasheet
FAQ

PM1611-WD | Pertanyaan Umum

Apakah PM1611-WD mendukung disconnect remote?
Ya. Built-in relay memungkinkan remote connect/disconnect via WiFi or 4G cellular. Tanpa kunjungan lokasi for activation, tenant changeovers, or non-payment disconnections. Service control from your dashboard.
Bagaimana cara kerja sistem token prabayar?
Tenants top-up credit via app, e-wallet, or your billing portal. The meter consumes credit based on real-time energi usage and auto-memutus saat saldo nol. Low-balance alerts notify before cut-off.
Apakah tarif multi-tarif dapat dikonfigurasi?
Ya. Set peak/off-peak rates, flat tariffs, or custom plans per tenant. Time-of-use schedules automatically apply correct rates. Useful for apartments with different tenant agreements or commercial sub-metering.
Opsi notifikasi apa yang tersedia?
Local LCD displays balance and consumption. WhatsApp, SMS, and email notifications fire on low balance, top-ups, anomalies (over-current, tampering), and scheduled reports.
